title: fix(plugin-audit): render the activity summary in the reader's language
body:
Fixes #26167

Clause-②: no (no exported type, schema field or spec key changes; the code rides in the existing `sys_activity.metadata` JSON, and `summary` keeps its type and meaning)
Metadata-protocol: none

Maintainer ruling on the card: 「同意，立卡」. The activity summary is stored as its message key plus params and rendered in the **reader's** language, as the approvals precedents do (#25627, the `admin_rescue` note; #24977). The English sentence stays in `summary` as the fallback text.

## What changed

The code is all in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit`. One docs row changes too: `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 45 now cites the new read site, because `check-system-context-census` requires every elevation read to have an anchor. No `packages/spec/**` file and no `ui/**` file is touched, so the serial rule with PR #26055 holds.

- **New `activity-summary-message.ts`.** It holds one composer, `composeActivitySummary`, which the writer and the reader both use. The code is one of three shapes:
  - `activityCreated` / `activityDeleted` / `activityUpdated` with `{object, label}`
  - `activityUpdatedFields` with `{object, label, fields, more}`
  - `fieldChanges` with `{object, changes: [{field, from, to}]}`, where each side is `{text, option?}`
  
  The object param is the object **name**. Object, field and option labels are resolved per reader from that reader's pack (`objects.NAME.label`, `…fields.FIELD.label`, `…options.VALUE`), with the authored label as the fallback.
- **The writer (`audit-writers.ts`).** Each CRUD mirror row stores the English sentence in `summary` and the code in `metadata.summary_message`. The write no longer asks for a locale for the summary. Milestone summaries (the #7290 path) store no code and keep their authored text.
- **The reader (`installActivitySummaryLocale`, registered in `audit-plugin.ts` after `installActivityFieldRedaction`).** It is an engine middleware on `sys_activity` `find` / `findOne`.
  - It negotiates `ctx.context.locale` against the held packs with `resolveBundleLocale`, so a bare `zh` reads the zh-CN pack.
  - It composes the summary in that locale and overlays `summary`.
  - When the projection names `summary` only, it adds `metadata` and removes it again afterwards.
  - It drops the code from `metadata` for every caller that is not the system, because its params are field values.
  - Middleware is an onion, so the field redaction, registered earlier, still judges the composed text.
  - A reader locale with no template, or a code this version cannot compose, keeps the stored sentence.

**Hypothesis A held: rendering happens on read, on the server.** The Discussion feed fetches its rows with `dataSource.find('sys_activity', …)` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-activity.tsx`) and shows `row.summary` (`recordActivityFeed.ts`). The authenticated fetch sends `Accept-Language` on every API call (`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts`), and the REST door resolves it into the caller context's `locale`. So the server overlay changes what the feed shows, with no UI change, and Hypothesis B was not needed.

## Rows written before this change

They **stay as written**, for every reader. There is no migration and no backfill, and no row is dropped. A row with no `summary_message` in its `metadata` is served its stored `summary` unchanged. This is pinned by the last case of the integration test, which uses a row in the earlier `{ old, new }` metadata shape.

## Tests

The red test came first, in commit cb6b6af2: `src/activity-summary-reader-locale.integration.test.ts`. It runs on a real kernel with ObjectQL, SQLite, a security double and AuditPlugin. It writes as the system with the workspace locale left at `en`, then reads as a zh-CN caller.

- **On `main` (fbb75998)** it fails 4 and passes 3: `Expected: "创建了 合同 "NDA""`, `Received: "Created Contract "NDA""`, and the lock reported `VERDICT command-exit 1`.
- **On this branch** all cases pass. A zh-CN reader gets `创建了 合同 "NDA"`, `阶段: 草稿 → 已签署` and `更新了 合同 "NDA"：备注`. The system, an en-US reader and a reader with no locale get the English sentences. A bare `zh` is negotiated to zh-CN, and fr-FR keeps the stored text. The code is served only to the system. A `fields: ['summary']` projection still composes. A reader who is not served `note` gets no summary for that row. A row written before the change keeps its text.

The unit tests for the composer and the overlay are in `src/activity-summary-message.test.ts`.

Six existing suites pinned the summary being localized at write time. They now assert the stored English sentence plus the text a reader gets through the same overlay, using `src/__tests__/summary-as-read.ts`. The workspace-locale and host-locale suites now pin the remaining write-locale consumer, which is the @mention notification title (`Ada 提到了你`). One new case asserts that an audited write asks for no locale at all.

Local results:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 62 passed (62), Tests 1013 passed (1013), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck` (which includes `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- eslint scoped to `packages/plugins/plugin-audit`: exit 0.
- **Ablation.** I disabled the one registration line, `installActivitySummaryLocale(engine as any, getI18n);` in `audit-plugin.ts`, using `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The integration test then failed 4 and passed 3, the same as on `main`. The restore matched the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- **dispatch-gates.** `--commands` on this diff derives 102 families. All 102 ran and exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles as 102 derived, 102 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Five of them were re-run before they went green:
  - `check-system-context-census` found the new read site with no anchor on the page. The docs row above fixes it.
  - `check:query-options-erasure` found one new erased options bag in the tests. The new tests now pass typed options.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` failed on a shallow clone and passed after unshallowing.
  - `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` failed for missing builds and passed after building.

## Acceptance notes

- **Search reads English now.** `summary` is `searchable`, and its stored text is now the English sentence wherever the workspace locale is set. So in a Chinese workspace, full-text search over `summary` matches the English words for rows written after this change. This follows the ruling that the English sentence is the fallback text. The same goes for an export of the raw column.
- **The write locale still chooses the language of @mention notification titles.** That is `AuditPluginOptions.getLocale`, otherwise the localization settings. Only its doc comment changed.
- **Not measured: the hotclm `pnpm demo:zh` Console check.** That repo is outside this session. The read path was measured from the code above and is pinned end to end by the integration test.
